question: What is the main goal of systems integration?
choices: To build a single monolithic application
To make different subsystems work together as a unified whole
answer: To make different subsystems work together as a unified whole
explanation: Systems integration combines separate components or subsystems into one functioning, cohesive system.

question: Which architecture style structures an application as small, independently deployable services?
explanation: Microservices architecture breaks an application into small, independent services that communicate over a network, each deployable on its own.
